#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Astroneer server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/astroneer/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/astroneer/gamedash-servers/test/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/AstroServerSettings.ini" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()     # keep its line endings
bom = "\ufeff" if t.startswith("\ufeff") else ""
t = t[len(bom):]
for key, val in (
    ('ServerPassword', join),
    ('ConsolePassword', admin),
):
    line = key + '=' + val
    pattern = r'(?m)^' + re.escape(key + '=') + r'[^\r\n]*'
    if re.search(pattern, t):
        t = re.sub(pattern, lambda m: line, t)
    else:
        pass   # not in the file: left out
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(bom + t)
SYNC
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/astroneer/gamedash-servers/test/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/AstroServerSettings.ini" <<'ADDR'
import re, socket, sys, urllib.request
for url in ("https://api.ipify.org", "https://checkip.amazonaws.com", "https://ifconfig.me/ip"):
    try:
        ip = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=6).read(64).decode("ascii", "replace").strip()
        socket.inet_aton(ip)
    except Exception:
        continue
    t = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()
    t = re.sub(r'(?m)^PublicIP=[^\r\n]*', lambda m: 'PublicIP=' + ip, t)
    open(sys.argv[1], "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(t)
    break
ADDR
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-gd-astroneer-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/astroneer/Astro/Binaries/Win64" || exit 1
exec wine ./AstroServer-Win64-Shipping.exe -log -userdir="Z:<WINROOT>\\installs\\astroneer\\gamedash-servers\\test\\"

#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed graceful stop: ask the server to save and quit, then wait.
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - 8778 "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'STOP'
import socket, sys, time
try:
    s = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1])), timeout=5)
    s.sendall(sys.argv[2].encode() + b"\n"); time.sleep(0.5)
    s.sendall(b"DSServerShutdown\n"); time.sleep(2); s.close()
except OSError:
    pass
STOP
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ] && pgrep -f -- 'gamedash-servers\\test\\' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-gd-astroneer-test" wineserver -k 2>/dev/null
exit 0
